subject: affxparser now builds on OSX w/ *PowerPC*

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: affxparser now builds on OSX w/ *PowerPC*
parts:
Hi,

just to let you know that Kasper kindly fixed the problem with
affxparser building on Mac OSX with the *PowerPC (PPC)* architecture.
This is the problem that Mark reported in his June 25 thread 'mac
compile error - affxparser'. This means affxparser should now install
all most common platforms, i.e. Linux, WinXP, and OSX.

The fix is available not only in the devel version but also the
release version of Bioconductor. The new release version is
affxparser v1.8.1. See also:

http://bioconductor.org/packages/2.0/bioc/html/affxparser.html

Note: It might take a few more days for the OSX *binary* to be
available from Bioc, but you can always build from the source.

I'm keen to hear from people using aroma.affymetrix on OSX w/ PPC.
Good news, please ;)

Cheers

Henrik
